name: "Alpha conversion bug"
about: "Report a fictional, non-sensitive reproduction of a Draft to Page issue"
title: "[alpha] "
---

**Privacy:** GitHub issues are public. Never include real drafts, private URLs, unpublished site details, credentials, clipboard contents, workspace backups, personal screenshots, or error messages containing private writing. Use fictional examples.

**Source and destination:** Word / copied Google Docs / HTML / Markdown / other, then WordPress / Word / Markdown / HTML / other.

**Device / browser family:** Desktop / tablet / phone, and browser name. Exact versions optional.

**Step:** File selection / paste / preview / import review / apply / edit / copy / download / WordPress save/reopen / recovery.

**Expected:**

**Observed (safe wording only):**

**Was any writing lost?** Yes / No / Unknown. Check original and last paragraph; do not paste its text.

**Fictional reproduction (optional):** Describe buttons and a short invented article.

**Content-free build summary (optional):** https://drafttopage.com/help/alpha-support/

**Severity / workaround:** Blocked / data loss / wrong conversion / export failure / cosmetic; workaround if tried.

Only report actions actually observed. Leave untested steps as NOT_RUN.
